rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Rubric hint: 3 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m, so MEDIUM.
Within 250 m there are 2 site-bound forest NT fungi (Hydnellum peckii, Sarcodon squamosus), 2023 records, 233-249 m away, uncertainty 25 m; below the 3-species MEDIUM threshold on their own.
Completed felling overlaps only 2.5% of the polygon (3.53 ha), so not ALREADY_FELLED.
Effort is adequate (349 records, 98th percentile; 24 records within 250 m, none inside the polygon).

uncertainties: Records beyond 250 m were not inspected individually; species identity and distances come from the rubric hint only.
Records show species were recorded, not that they occupy the site now.
not_established: Presence or absence of species inside the polygon (no records inside, which is not absence).
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should check the eligible species records in the 250-1000 m rings and the NT fungus records near the edge, and consider a field survey of the stand before felling.
